summary: Temporary drone restricted area up to 2,200 ft within 1 nautical mile of a point at Portmoak, Perth and Kinross; police permission needed.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (PORTMOAK,
PERTH AND KINROSS). WI 1NM RADIUS OF PSN 561034N 0032122W PILOTS ARE 
FORBIDDEN TO FLY UAS WITHIN THE DESIGNATED AREA WITHOUT THE 
PERMISSION OF POLICE SCOTLAND, CTC TEL 0300-4325422. RESTRICTION OF 
FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR NAV ORDER 2016. 
AR-2026-11090/01.
